title: Amazon Basics Space Heater for Indoor Use with PTC Ceramic Technology, 1500W, Remote Control, 70° Oscillation, Digital Controls, 16-inch, Grey

ADVANCED SAFETY FEATURES: Triple protection with tip-over switch, overheat protection, and enhanced safety plug; Ultra-quiet operation at 40 dB in low mode
SMART CONVENIENCE: Digital display with remote control; 24-hour programmable timer; Energy-saving ECO mode automatically adjusts output to maintain desired temperature
PORTABLE & USER-FRIENDLY: Built-in carry handle; Convenient remote control storage; 70° wide oscillation for even heat distribution; Compact design perfect for bedrooms, offices, and living spaces
COMPACT & PRACTICAL DESIGN: Efficient size at 6"L x 6"W x 16"H, perfect balance of power and space-saving design
